failures.summary: The first exact x2 staging wrapper yielded without a usable result while its legitimate Git add process continued in the background; no staged state was inferred from the missing wrapper output.
An explicit duplicate add attempt was rejected because the live staging process still held the Git index lock; the rejected call changed no repository state and earned zero credit.

A read-only PowerShell status projection used question marks as wildcard characters and incorrectly classified staged additions as untracked; it earned zero validation credit and changed no repository state.
